tasks.title: Inventory release evidence and preserve the front door

acceptance.description: Inventory release evidence and preserve the front door with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: Every proposed material claim has an owner, real entry point, revision and a result with its environment. Unverified claims have explicit limits. Historic broad capabilities missing from the proposed outline are restored or given an intentional, resolvable destination.

evidence.command: Compare each README front-door claim with the owner, local entry point, source revision, frozen fixture digests, observed result, environment and limits in the claim inventory.

acceptance.description: Write the coordination README with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: A first-time reader can use the new task table to complete one AI-system journey and one assisted-software journey. A relevant non-AI route still works. Each example resolves on this checkout. No prototype, metadata check, vendor benchmark or planned work is described as a verified production capability.

evidence.command: Independent first-use walkthrough: follow README task rows, replay classifier and coding evidence journeys, validate the ordinary handoff fixture, and inspect the explicit non-AI route limitation.

tasks.title: Validate and release the rewritten README

acceptance.description: Validate and release the rewritten README with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: All material links and anchors resolve or have a working compatibility anchor. Each changed command is exercised or explicitly qualified. Capabilities appears among the first four H2 headings. Dated results match the tested revision; an independent reader locates the cases, artifacts and limitations.

evidence.command: README metrics, preservation, local Markdown targets, documented schema and route examples, disposable-checkout pytest, and owner-reported independent reader result; see receipt for exact commands and outcomes.
